*Confidential Healthcare AI Startup | Senior Full Stack Engineer (Frontend-Leaning) | NYC | Hybrid (3 days onsite) | Full-Time | $160K–$200K + Equity*

I'm an independent recruiter sourcing for a venture-backed healthcare technology startup building an AI-powered Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform for dental practices.

The company has raised $50M+ and is looking for a senior, frontend-focused engineer to help build a new product from the ground up while contributing to its established B2B marketplace.

*Tech Stack:* React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Django.

*Requirements:* - 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, primarily frontend. - Strong production experience with React and TypeScript. - Solid UI architecture, state management, and performance optimization skills. - Experience with TanStack Query/Router or similar tools. - Ability to own features end-to-end, including backend APIs. - Comfortable using AI coding agents and critically reviewing their output.

Experience with healthcare, payments, billing, or B2B SaaS is a plus.

*Location:* Must already be based in NYC and comfortable working onsite 3 days per week.

*Compensation:* $160K–$200K base + equity.

The interview includes a hands-on coding session using your own laptop and preferred AI development tools.

If interested, email your resume, LinkedIn/GitHub, and a brief description of a production React/TypeScript feature you've owned to *mernaahmedemara13@gmail.com*.

Subject: Senior Full Stack Engineer – NYC
